scope: Cover the plain DRW_Dimension base-class writer route in the generated seven-revision ASCII/Binary dimension transaction matrix.

source.kind: records authored from scratch in memory and serialized beneath the build test directory
profiles: plain DRW_Dimension instance with default subtype 0, nondefault common points, style, and text
seven standard concrete DIMENSION subtypes, current/legacy dynamic-constraint profiles, ARC_DIMENSION, and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION in the same generated drawing

implementation.method: Prime each version and encoding, measure allocation attempts in the clean full write, inject std::bad_alloc at each offset, require failure plus unchanged destination and caller state, retry with the same codec, compare exact clean bytes, and freshly read the base-class record through the callback selected by its DXF subtype.

limitations: Generated DXF transaction and self-readback evidence only; producer interoperability, independent semantics, and native rendering are not qualified.
Subtype 0 is delivered through the linear-dimension callback by current DXF reader dispatch; this receipt does not establish broader semantic interpretation of arbitrary plain base-class records.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: The plain DRW_Dimension base-class writer route now has generated whole-operation ASCII/Binary rollback, caller-state preservation, same-codec retry, byte-identical output, and typed callback readback across AC1014/AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032.
planImpact.remainingP6G: P6-G remains open for public-writer inventory reconciliation, remaining direct routes and compound variants, and uncovered variable-size OBJECTS builders.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 300 completed slices and 34 remaining packages: 300/(300+34)=89.8%; equal-weight count, not effort-weighted.
